# Test cases of the semver package, kept as data, in gotgan's case format.
#
# One case per line: ARGS|STDIN|STDOUT. ARGS is the command line of tests/driver.bmb
# (the operation, and for matches and cmp the versions), STDIN the text it reads (a
# version, a requirement, a comparator or a pre-release), STDOUT what it must write,
# both with the escapes \\ and \xHH. Lines that start with # are comments.
#
# Transcribed from the original crate's tests (tests/test_version.rs,
# tests/test_version_req.rs, tests/test_identifier.rs) by a script. The comparisons
# whose exact result the origin does not state (assert_ne!, <=, >=, negations), the
# equalities of requirements and the requirements the origin only parses are in
# reference.txt, with the results the crate gives.

# ---- tests/test_version.rs ----
